The '''glass-cleaning fish''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] found in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The streams of [[Water/Legends|water]] that flowed down the [[Saeduree River Shipping Tower]] contained glass-cleaning fish.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
